title: German soccer star faces backlash for goal celebration honoring Christ
description: ( LifeSiteNews ) — Felix Nmecha, the star midfielder for Borussia Dortmund (BVB), sparked intense backlash from the soccer club, its fans, and the German national team (DFB) for celebrating a goal with a gesture giving the glory to Christ last weekend. After scoring both goals in a 2-1 win over SV Elversberg on November 7, Nmecha, a non-denominational Christian, dropped to one knee, pointed toward Heaven, and mimed taking a crown off his head and placing it on the ground, giving glory to Our Lord. … READ: German soccer team starts ‘internal process’ against player for post supporting Charlie Kirk “May the Lord be with the Kirk family during this time with special grace. Jesus is the true path to peace and love,” the soccer star wrote in one post. In another post, which has since been deleted, Nmecha wrote that Kirk had “peacefully stood up for his convictions and values, adding that “celebrating” an attack on a father and husband is “truly evil.”

title: Canadian veterans offered euthanasia over care are suing the federal gov’t
description: ( LifeSiteNews ) — Canada’s federal government will soon face a class-action lawsuit from multiple Canadian veterans who were offered euthanasia instead of proper treatment for their illness. Alberta attorney Catherine Christensen said that, according to a Daily Mail report , she is getting the class action against the government moving. … Veterans Affairs Canada has told the media its “employees have no role or mandate to recommend or raise (MAiD). ” As reported by LifeSiteNews, this is not the first report of CAF veterans saying they were offered MAiD. Indeed, as reported by LifeSiteNews, it was revealed last year that the federal department in charge of helping Canadian veterans appears to have purposefully prevented the existence of a paper after scandalous reports surfaced alleging that caseworkers had recommended euthanasia to suffering service members.

title: Jim Caviezel says Muslims want to kill him: ‘I have a fatwa on me’
